title: My Project Notifications
message: Introducing My Project Notifications, a new feature that keeps you updated with the latest changes and improvements in the My Project. Stay informed about new releases, bug fixes, and enhancements directly from the development team.

title: Offsets in My Project
message: If you see an error message saying "Could not read memory at", this does not mean that there is a program error. We have no influence on the operation of offsets. Please wait for the a2x/cs2-dumper offset update.

title: VACNet Anti-Cheat Update Warning
message: VACNet, the anti-cheat system for Counter-Strike 2, has been significantly improved. Using My Project or similar tools may result in detection and bans. Proceed with caution and use at your own risk.

title: Important VACNet Anti-Cheat Update Notice
message: Attention Counter-Strike 2 players: The recent VACNet anti-cheat update has enhanced detection capabilities. Continuous use of trigger bots or similar tools, including My Project, from start to finish in matches may lead to detection, resulting in account restrictions of 20 hours or more. There is no issue with the tools themselves, but aggressive use increases the risk of detection. Please play cautiously and at your own risk to avoid bans.
